x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — Workspace not found.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Verify <workspace-id> and the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — A view in viewIds does not exist.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Verify the IDs via Get View List.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: SECURITYNOTPERMITTED — Request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain, the user lacks Create Email Schedule permission, or lacks Export permission on a view in viewIds.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Call from the standard API host with the required permissions.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: OBJIDNOTBELONGSTODB — A view in viewIds belongs to a different workspace.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Include only views from <workspace-id>.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: INVALIDEXPORTTYPE — exportType is not one of the supported formats.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Use CSV, XLS, PDF, HTML, or IMG.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: DUPLICATESCHEDULE — A schedule with this scheduleName already exists in the workspace.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Choose a different name.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: MAILCOUNTPERSCHEDEXCEED — Too many recipients for a single schedule.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Reduce the recipient list, or split it across schedules.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: MAILMULTIVIEWMAXCOUNTEXCEEEDED — Too many views in one schedule.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Reduce viewIds, or split across schedules.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: EMAILEXPORTDISABLEDINORG — Email export is disabled for this organization.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Ask the Organization Admin to enable export in Security Controls.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: UNTRUSTEDEMAILIDS — A recipient address is outside the organization's trusted domains.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Use trusted-domain addresses, or ask the Organization Admin to add the domain.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: EMAILINGVIEWDISABLED — Emailing this view is disabled.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Check the view's and workspace's export settings.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: MAILSCHSELECTATLEASTONEEMAILID — No recipient could be resolved from emailIds, groupIds, and cc.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Supply at least one address or a non-empty group.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: ONLYONEDASHBOARDISALLOWEDPERSCH — More than one view scheduled where the first is a dashboard.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Schedule the dashboard on its own.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: EXPORTFORMATSALLOWEDFORDASHBOARD — Dashboard scheduled with a format other than PDF/HTML.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Use PDF or HTML.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: EXPORTFORMATSALLOWEDFORCHART — IMG requested for a view that is not a chart.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Use IMG only for chart views.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: ONLYONEVIEWISALLOWEDFORXLS — XLS requested with more than one view.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Send exactly one view, or choose another format.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: INVALIDVALUEFORATTRIBUTE — A scheduleDetails value is out of range (e.g. hour outside 0–23, minute not a multiple of 5, weekDays outside 1–7, months outside 1–12, skipFrequency beyond the limit for the chosen frequency).
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: The error message names the attribute and its permitted range; correct the value.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: SYSTEMTAGDATAWARNINGV2VALIDATIONCONFIRMATION — A view carries a restricted DATAWARNING system tag.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Review the warning, then resend with "validateSystemTags": false.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: INVALIDOAUTHTOKEN — Invalid or expired OAuth token.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.create.

Identical to `summary`. Make the renderer fall back to it.

1.value:
Note:
The attributes inside scheduleDetails apply based on the calendarFrequency value.
  • weekDay and weekDays - applicable for weekly schedules.
  • weekNumber, monthDay and monthDays - applicable for monthly schedules.
  • months - applicable for yearly schedules, along with the relevant day attributes.

2.value:
Note:
validateSystemTags is applicable only when System Tags are enabled for your organization. When it is set to true, a view listed in viewIds that carries an Outdated tag - applied directly, or inherited through lineage from a parent Data Source or Table - causes the request to be rejected, and no views are shared.
